title: ervum ciliare
intro: Ervum ciliare, commonly known as garden pea or Lathyrus sativus, is a legume plant used as a food source and for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Ervum ciliare include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and possess antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include isoflavones, saponins, and phenolic acids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. Additionally, Ervum ciliare has been traditionally used to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues.
